notes: ne_10m_ports.geojson is the complete, unmodified file captured from the official Natural Earth GitHub repository (nvkelso/natural-earth-vector, master, VERSION 5.2.0-pre): 1,081 ports, 279 KB. It replaces the NGA World Port Index, whose API (https://msi.nga.mil/api/publications/world-port-index?output=json) and documentation page returned HTTP 503 with an Akamai maintenance page on every attempt on the capture date. Reference data without timestamps. The malformed variant was authored by hand.
